title: Transdermal Testosterone Nanoemulsion in Women Libido
brief_summary: This is a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study. Seventy women, aged 35-75 years, with treatment-emergent loss of libido will be randomly allocated to the treatment with a Transdermal nanoemulsion of Testosterone (500mcg) delivering 300 mcg of testosterone/day or an identical placebo nanoemulsion (PLA) for 12 weeks.
